item.title: Tuberville faces challenge of residency
item.description: This week, Ken McFeeters — a Republican candidate for Alabama Governor — officially filed a complaint challenging the residency of Tommy Tuberville, also running for governor. Tuberville — the longtime former college football coach — is currently a U.S. Senator representing Alabama. Last year, he announced his intention to run for the governor’s office. item.title: Troy’s Donta Frazier inducted into Faulkner Athletics Hall of Fame
item.description: Troy native Donta Frazier and Faulkner’s 2001 NAIA championship basketball team entered the university’s Athletics Hall of Fame on the title’s 25th anniversary, the first team ever inducted.

item.title: Jordon Tucker promoted to Supervisor of Operations in Alabama for Tower Loan
item.description: Recently, Tower Loans announced that Alabama resident Jordon Tucker has been promoted to Supervisor of Operations for its Alabama branches. Tucker will oversee operations in Alabama, which includes offices in Troy, Alexander City, Bessemer, Auburn, Eufaula, Pell City and Dothan. item.title: Troy rallies from 21-point deficit to secure Rigby's 500th win
item.description: Troy storms back from 21 down to edge Marshall 85-82, delivering women's coach Chanda Rigby her 500th career win and moving her within three victories of Troy's all-time mark.

item.title: Pike County road closed due to accident
item.description: A two-vehicle crash involving a commercial vehicle that occurred at approximately 10:06 a.m. Thursday, Jan. 29, has caused roadway blockage. Alabama 87 near Pike County 3350, in Pike County, is currently blocked and will be for an undetermined amount of time. Traffic has been diverted to Pike County 3350. Troopers with the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency’s (ALEA) Highway Patrol Division will continue to monitor the situation and provide updates accordingly.

item.title: Akropolis to perform at First Baptist Thursday night
item.description: Akropolis will perform a public concert at 7 p.m. Thursday night at First Baptist Church in Troy. Tickets for the evening concert are $20 for general admission and may be purchased at the door or online at troyartscouncil.net . Admission is free for students and educators with valid identification. The Troy Arts Council sponsored a free Akropolis concert for elementary school students in Pike County Thursday morning at the Claudia Crosby Theater on the Troy University campus. item.title: Commission relocates polling location in Spring Hill
item.description: The Pike County Commission approved the relocation of its voting location in Spring Hill. The old location was at the Spring Hill Housing Authority located at 22 County Road 2331. item.title: Troy Resilience Project undergoing recertification process
